description: GTM engineering plan for one country: creator platforms to seed on, marketplaces to research, buyer channels, local-language and disclosure rules, product compliance pointers (with an official source link), the official tariff lookup and Korea FTA, and the treg.to endpoint ids (with per-call prices and example request bodies) to run creator discovery, vetting, marketplace research, social listening, ad-library and buyer-contact steps. Estimated data cost included.

country.description: Target country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. 'US', 'JP') or an English/Korean name.

description.description: Optional: the product as the user describes it, any language (e.g. '비건 선크림 SPF50', '할랄 인증 저가 립스틱', 'premium anti-aging ampoule already on Amazon US'). Used to detect product traits that change the rules within one HS code (see traits) and the concepts, price tier, certifications and markets already selling that change which market fits (product_profile, entry_paths).

item.description: Product as an HS4 code (e.g. '3304') or a name in English or Korean (e.g. 'sunscreen', '라면'). Names cover TradeGraph's 35 items; any other product works as a 4-digit HS code (e.g. '1905' biscuits, '2005' kimchi, '3305' shampoo) with live UN Comtrade imports. Optional; adds niche keywords and compliance pointers.

motion.description: Which part of the plan to return. 'all' adapts to the item: industrial goods get b2b, trade and search only.

traits.description: Optional: product traits, comma-separated, that change the rules within one HS code: sunscreen, whitening (also arbutin, kojic acid), vitamin_a (retinol), gel_nail (UV/LED gel, semi-cured strips), contact_lens (HS 9001: contact lenses, colour lenses), hair_dye, hair_loss, acne, antiperspirant, dandruff, fluoride (toothpaste), human_derived (human stem cell culture media, human placenta, cord blood: a ban in the EU, UK, China and ASEAN), stem_cell (stem cell culture media whose source is not named: check it), exosome, radio (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular), battery, meat, dairy, egg, aerosol, flammable, industrial or household (for HS codes that hold both, such as 8414 fans, compressors and vacuum pumps: picks machinery rules, trade fairs and buyer searches, or household-appliance ones). Also detected from item, product and description; the answer lists them in product_traits.

name: channel_plan
title: Channels, creators and live-data calls for a country
